front: Name the four main changes of state.

back: Evaporation: at the surface, any temperature. Boiling: throughout, at the boiling point.
A direct change from solid to gas (e.g. iodine, dry ice).

front: Is the white 'steam' from a kettle a gas?
back: No: it is tiny droplets of condensed liquid water; water vapour is invisible.
